annotations.title: Show your Pixly balance and this month's spend

description: Shows the signed-in user's balance, this month's spend so far and projected total, and what awake servers cost per hour. Call it when the user asks about their balance or spending. It cannot add funds. When the user asks to add funds: show the balance and addFunds with a link to dashboardUrl, and no other link, no button, amount, total after adding or steps.
